publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.5.24 documents the required hosted owner name and shows how to pass --owner-name on a fresh checkout. Dry runs report missing or invalid inputs and exit with status 3 without contacting Cloudflare. The monitor editor shows and enforces the one-minute minimum for Cloudflare Worker checks. Mobile Settings wraps long installation names beside the logo and leaves room for Sign out. The guides explain how to list monitor names from CLI .rer archives and console JSON backups, export and verify a D1 backup before removal, and verify a tag-scoped Monitoring read key using tagged and untagged monitors. The @runeditrun/rer pin stays at 0.2.130. All 91 SQL migrations from 0.5.23 are byte-identical, with zero new migrations or required settings. Existing monitors, history, incidents, destinations, and private settings are retained. Before upgrading, use Settings > Backup and files > Download backup with a second factor verified within five minutes. Keep private settings and .rer/deploy separately, plus a hosted database backup if applicable. For a CLI backup, verify the native session while dev is running, stop dev, and use the verified UPTIME_ACCESS_COOKIE to run rer export --output exports/uptime.rer within five minutes. Keep the cookie private. Update with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile. Stop dev or preview before deploying, keep the deployment receipt, and use the existing installation keys. The mail configuration guidance and known limits in the changelog still apply. Product screenshot available from 0.4.0 at .github/assets/release/uptime-0.4.0-monitor-1440.png. — Run Edit Run fleet, 2026-11-22.
